notes.title: The Game has been released!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40157456/c9abe2c2305aba1039bb64e666ec1118cd2d269a.png
Congratulations on the release of the new intellectual projet "HENTAI PRINCESS"!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40157456/411db4f71358cadb122261d2160f51eff58b00d9.png
If you like our game and want to support the authors, then hurry up and tell ALL your friends about the release of "HENTAI PRINCESS"!

The more people know about our game, the better chance we have of getting access to creating collectible cards!

So let's get active in the comments! Write what you think about our game!
